build_ResEncoder_model: build a ResEncoder model with configurable LSTM hidden sizes and classifier layers for NLI classification
run_ResEncoder_forward: run the ResEncoder forward pass with input_ids and attention_mask to get logits and loss
init_ResEncoder_embedding: initialize the ResEncoder embedding weights from a pretrained embedding matrix
build_BagOfWords_model: build a BagOfWords model with average pooling over embeddings for NLI classification
run_BagOfWords_forward: run the BagOfWords forward pass with input_ids and attention_mask to get logits and loss
